name: B10-0091/2024 (Renew) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law itself. It is asking the European Union to speak out against a new Iraqi bill on family matters. Under the bill, marriage, divorce and child custody would move to religious courts, and girls as young as nine could marry. The Parliament also asks the European Union to tie development aid to training judges and setting up shelters for women, and to help Iraq prosecute sexual violence crimes.

- The bill is not law yet; a final vote was postponed on 2 October.
- It affects Iraqi women and girls, especially on marriage and custody.
- The European Union is asked to publicly object and press Iraq to drop the bill.
